about: FAKE synthetic corpus for SymVeil leak measurement. Company Exempla, product Tundrahorn (TDH). No real employer, person, host, or product. Identity numbers use year 2099 and the checksums from the in-tree fixtures or the same Luhn rule. Phones use 000.

items.repro: POST /v1/messages with the canary as a JSON object key (session json-key), not inside a string. The file corpus does not contain this value.
items.fix: redact_value walks object values and skips keys, so a covered token used as a JSON key is sent upstream. Run the same string scan on object keys. Canary id: aws-json-key.

items.carrier:
-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----
SVCNOPENSSHKEYLINE0001
-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----

items.repro: firmware/tundrahorn_fan.c string blob. Decodes to the fake sentence SVCN-base64-plaintext-secret-0001. Sent as file text in messages and responses sessions. high_entropy is false.
items.fix: Decode standard and URL-safe base64 spans of at least 16 characters and run the builtin secret rules on the decoded text. Mask the encoded span when the decode hits a secret. Leave high_entropy opt-in: it also masks non-secrets and it skips hex, and it is off by default. Canary ids: base64-short, base64-long, base64-aws.

items.repro: firmware/tundrahorn_fan.c string blob_long, 232 characters, entropy above 4.5. high_entropy is false in the evaluated config.
items.fix: Decode standard and URL-safe base64 spans of at least 16 characters and run the builtin secret rules on the decoded text. Mask the encoded span when the decode hits a secret. Leave high_entropy opt-in: it also masks non-secrets and it skips hex, and it is off by default. Canary ids: base64-short, base64-long, base64-aws.

items.repro: firmware/tundrahorn_fan.c string encoded_key. Standard base64 of the fake key AKIASVCNENCODEDKEY01, which is not itself present in the corpus.
items.fix: Decode standard and URL-safe base64 spans of at least 16 characters and run the builtin secret rules on the decoded text. Mask the encoded span when the decode hits a secret. Leave high_entropy opt-in: it also masks non-secrets and it skips hex, and it is off by default. Canary ids: base64-short, base64-long, base64-aws.

items.repro: POST /v1/responses with this 12-digit fictional 2099 personnummer as a JSON number, not a string (session json-number).
items.fix: redact_value ignores JSON numbers, so a personnummer stored as a number bypasses the text rule. Scan the decimal spelling of numbers, or scan the raw JSON before parsing. Canary id: pn-json.

items.repro: ops/agent-settings.json allowedCommands contains mysql -pSVCNAgentPassw0rd. The same line is in home/jdoe/.bash_history. Sent as a tool result.
items.fix: No builtin covers a password glued to -p or --password. Add a secret rule for that flag, or document that shell snippets are out of scope. Canary id: agent-pass.

items.repro: ops/docker-inspect.json Env entry "TDH_API_TOKEN=svcn-docker-opaque-0001" (quote before the name). Sent as a tool result.
items.fix: env-assignment requires the name at line start. Accept an optional quote before the name so docker inspect Env arrays match, or rescan after stripping one pair of quotes. Canary id: docker-opaque.

items.repro: ops/pytest-traceback.txt prints os.environ as environ({'TDH_DB_PASSWORD': 'svcn-pytest-opaque-0001'}). The notebook output cell repeats it.
items.fix: A pytest repr is not an env line, and \b does not hold between _ and PASSWORD. Recognize quoted names that end in _KEY, _SECRET, _TOKEN, _PASSWORD, or _PASS. Canary id: pytest-opaque.

items.repro: firmware/tundrahorn_fan.c splits a fake key across adjacent string literals "AKIASVCNSPLIT" "KEY001". Neither fragment matches aws-access-key-id.
items.fix: Regex detectors do not reassemble split tokens. Document that limit. A fix would have to join adjacent string literals before scanning, which this tree does not do.

items.repro: Second half of the split fake key in firmware/tundrahorn_fan.c.
items.fix: Same as split-left. KEY001 alone is not a secret shape; together with the previous literal it would be.

items.repro: Comment in firmware/tundrahorn_fan.c. Every label contains an underscore (db_backup.fan_line.internal), so internal-hostname does not match. A suffix without an underscore, such as tundrahorn.internal, is still masked.
items.fix: internal-hostname labels are [a-z0-9-]. Allow underscores in labels. Canary id: host-underscore.

items.repro: Bare glpat- token in a firmware comment. GITLAB_TOKEN= in configs/fan.env is a different value and is an env assignment.
items.fix: Add a builtin or a [[redact.secrets]] rule for \bglpat-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}\b. Canary id: gitlab-bare.

items.repro: Comment AccountKey=svcn-azure-bare-0001 in firmware. AZURE_STORAGE_KEY= in fan.env is covered as an env assignment.
items.fix: Add a rule for AccountKey= or document that only named env assignments are covered. Canary id: azure-bare.

items.repro: xoxb- token whose body is 49 characters. The builtin allows 10 to 48.
items.fix: Raise the slack-token upper bound. Canary id: slack-long.

items.repro: sk-admin- token in a firmware comment. README says this shape is not covered.
items.fix: Documented exception. Add sk-admin- and sk-svcacct- to openai-api-key if they should be masked. Canary id: sk-admin.
